label: <DEL> step of maximum-length (L=9) sequences
explanation: Fires almost exclusively on the <DEL> delimiter step (98% of activation mass), and there mainly when the sequence has the maximum length L=9 (about 68% of L=9 delimiters fire, 95% of mass). It fires weakly on some L=8 delimiters (about 4% of mass) and sometimes very weakly on the first copy step (t=L+1, under 2% of mass). It never fires during the original-input phase or later in the copy phase. Within L=9 delimiters, which ones fire depends partly on the first original token, the one about to be output (o, 1, l, x, n, c, f, 0 fire more often), and on having more digits in the sequence, but neither of these splits the cases cleanly, so precision stays around 0.68.
